relations.name: file
relations.description: One package's observation of a source file. A path that two packages read has two rows; Atlas never picks an owner.

columns.name: path
columns.description: Path relative to the workspace root.

columns.name: package
columns.description: The Cargo package that reads the file.

columns.name: test_only
columns.description: The package reads it only in a test build (a test target, or under a test module).

columns.name: fingerprint
columns.description: FNV-1a 64-bit content fingerprint; a change detector, not a security digest.

notes: Includes files no module declaration reaches (disconnected source): they have no mount row.

relations.name: mount
relations.description: A module path at which a package's Cargo target reaches a file through `mod` declarations.

columns.name: root
columns.description: The Cargo target root the path starts from.

columns.name: module_path
columns.description: Modules from the target root, joined with `::`; empty for the root file itself.

columns.name: target
columns.description: The Cargo target, when several share the root; otherwise empty.

columns.name: test_only
columns.description: The target or a module on the path requires a test build.

notes: A file can have several mounts (several targets, or `#[path]`), or none.

relations.name: declaration
relations.description: A declaration site: an item Atlas read at a file and line. Not a resolved Rust symbol.

columns.name: id
columns.description: `path:line:name`. A file two packages read gives the same id in each package.

columns.name: package
columns.description: The package whose observation of the file this is.

columns.name: name
columns.description: The declared name as written (for an impl, its written head).

columns.name: kind
columns.description: Fn, Struct, Enum, Union, Trait, TypeAlias, Mod, MacroRules, PubUse, Const, Static, Impl, Use, MacroCall or Extern; an unknown tag is kept verbatim.

columns.name: visibility
columns.description: Written visibility: Pub, PubCrate, PubIn, PubSuper or Private. Not Rust's effective visibility.

columns.name: inline_modules
columns.description: Enclosing inline `mod` blocks in the file, outermost first, joined with `::`; empty at file level.

columns.name: test_only
columns.description: Inside a test module, or in a file the package reads only for tests.

notes: The key is (id, package). Count declarations per package observation, as `census` does.

relations.name: import
relations.description: A `use` declaration as written, per package observation of its file.

columns.name: written
columns.description: The `use` tree as written, without resolving it.

relations.name: mention
relations.description: A type name written in a declaration's signature or body, matched by spelling.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Mention id, unique within one export.

columns.name: source
columns.description: The declaration whose text holds the mention (`declaration.id`).

notes: Approximate: a spelling match, not compiler name resolution.

relations.name: mention_target
relations.description: A declaration a mention's spelling can name. An ambiguous mention has one row per candidate.

columns.name: basis
columns.description: `unique` when the spelling names one declaration; `candidate` when it names several and this is one of them.

notes: A `unique` basis is a unique spelling match, not proof that Rust resolves the name there.

relations.name: mention_unresolved
relations.description: A mention whose spelling Atlas could not match to a workspace declaration.

columns.name: reason
columns.description: Why it is unresolved, as Atlas reports it.

relations.name: diagnostic
relations.description: An observation Atlas could not complete while reading the source.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Witness id, unique within this relation in one export; not stable between exports.

columns.name: line
columns.description: The line, or 0 when the diagnostic is about the whole file.

columns.name: package
columns.description: The package whose observation it is, or empty for the physical file.

columns.name: message
columns.description: The diagnostic as written in Atlas's other output.

relations.name: qualified_file
relations.description: A production file the qualified analysis read.

columns.name: fingerprint
columns.description: Content fingerprint of the bytes analyzed.

notes: Production source only: test targets and test modules are outside the qualified population.

relations.name: function
relations.description: A function body the qualified analysis selected.

columns.name: name
columns.description: The name as written, with the impl type for a method (`Type::name`).

columns.name: qualified
columns.description: Module-qualified name, when Atlas could form one; otherwise empty.

columns.name: declaration
columns.description: The lexical `declaration.id` at the same file, line and name; empty if none matched.

relations.name: type
relations.description: A workspace struct, enum or type alias.

columns.name: qualified
columns.description: Module-qualified name, when Atlas could form one; otherwise empty.

columns.name: alias
columns.description: For a type alias, its right-hand side as written; empty for a struct or enum.

columns.name: declaration
columns.description: The lexical `declaration.id` at the same file, line and name; empty if none matched.

relations.name: field
relations.description: A field of a workspace struct or enum, with its type as written.

columns.name: position
columns.description: Position among the type's fields, from 0.

columns.name: name
columns.description: The field name, or its position for a tuple field.

relations.name: call
relations.description: A call whose target Atlas resolved to exactly one workspace function.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Witness id, unique within this relation in one export; not stable between exports.

notes: Only unique resolutions: an ambiguous or unresolved call is an `unknown_call` row, never a `call` row.
Calls inside closures and macro arguments are not observed.

relations.name: unknown_call
relations.description: A call Atlas could not resolve to exactly one workspace function: external, ambiguous or unsupported.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Witness id, unique within this relation in one export; not stable between exports.

columns.name: receiver
columns.description: The method receiver as written, or empty for a path call.

columns.name: reason
columns.description: Why the call is unresolved, as Atlas reports it.

notes: Includes calls into other crates and the standard library; an unknown call is not a missing call.

relations.name: reference
relations.description: A signature or field type that names exactly one workspace type.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Witness id, unique within this relation in one export; not stable between exports.

columns.name: from
columns.description: The function or type whose signature or field it is.

columns.name: slot
columns.description: The parameter, return or field it occupies.

columns.name: expression
columns.description: The entire written type, such as `Arc<Graph>`.

columns.name: borrow
columns.description: The written type is a reference.

notes: `Arc<Graph>` is a reference to Graph, not a claim that the function owns one.

relations.name: unknown_type
relations.description: A type spelling in a signature or field that Atlas did not resolve to one workspace type.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Witness id, unique within this relation in one export; not stable between exports.

columns.name: from
columns.description: The function or type whose signature or field it is.

columns.name: reason
columns.description: Why it is unresolved, as Atlas reports it.

columns.name: slot
columns.description: The parameter, return or field it occupies.

notes: Each mention is its own row: a generic argument such as the `u32` in `Vec<u32>` is a row of its own beside `Vec<u32>`.

relations.name: construction
relations.description: A struct literal or enum variant of a workspace type built in a function body.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Witness id, unique within this relation in one export; not stable between exports.

relations.name: default_call
relations.description: An explicit zero-argument `Type::default()` call for a workspace type.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Witness id, unique within this relation in one export; not stable between exports.

relations.name: constant
relations.description: A written `const` item and its value as syntax; nothing is evaluated.

columns.name: inline_modules
columns.description: Enclosing inline `mod` blocks, joined with `::`; empty at file level.

columns.name: value
columns.description: The value as JSON: `{"kind": ..., "value": ...}` with kind string, array, tuple, path, call or opaque.
